Guidehouse is hiring a Technical Associate Application Developer to develop and support enterprise applications and automations. The role supports application testing, releases, documentation, user adoption, and ongoing optimization while building software development skills.
Professional Services
Consulting
Government
Advice
Management Consulting
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Develop application features and automations based on defined requirements and technical designs
Troubleshoot routine issues for assigned components and escalate more complex problems to senior team members
Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve code quality, consistency, and technical skills
Learn and apply enterprise tools, platforms, source control practices, and SDLC processes in daily work
Use AI-assisted development tools, including GitHub Copilot, to support learning and productivity while following established review and security practices
Assist with testing, upgrades, releases, deployments, and change management activities
Document incidents, resolutions, configurations, and standard operating procedures
Participate in data validation, basic reporting, and application optimization initiatives
Support training efforts and help users adopt new systems or features
Operate with professionalism, attention to detail, and collaboration in a fast‑paced, team‑oriented environment

as JSON
Familiarity with source control tools such as Git and collaborative
development workflows
Basic scripting or programming experience (Python, JavaScript, PowerShell)
Interest in enterprise systems, business applications, or IT consulting
